## Detection honesty check

- [ ] New or changed detections have a fixture that fires AND one that does not
- [ ] No verdict or README claim is stronger than what the check establishes
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or it was discussed in an issue first)
- [ ] Test suite passes locally (`python -m pytest`)
- [ ] No real credentials, tokens, or third-party data in fixtures or examples
